summary: Iteration 319 — Phase 1 Parent & Customer-Specific Child SKU classification tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (allows_child_skus field on master-skus, toggle-off guard while children exist, POST validations — parent-toggle-off rejected, one-generic-per-parent, customer_account_id required, duplicate code and duplicate name blocked, customer_account_name denormalization; GET parent_sku_id + include_inactive; PUT active/label_version/is_active updates; DELETE hard delete when no txns returns deactivated:false; artwork upload/download round-trip against Emergent object storage). Frontend: full E2E on /sku-management verified — Parent badge on 24 Brand, allows_child_skus toggle ON in edit dialog, Child SKU Manager dialog with inherited-from-parent banner, Add Generic child + Add Customer child (account selected via searchable Radix Select with 12 accounts) with brand AquaX, Edit label version to v2 reflected in list, Delete both children -> empty state visible, button counter returns to Child SKUs (0). DB left clean; 24 Brand keeps allows_child_skus=true.
critical_code_review_comments: child_skus.py delete_child_sku: TXN_TOP_COLLECTIONS (factory_warehouse_stock, distributor_stock, warehouse_transfers) and delivery_orders.items.fulfilment_child_sku_id are checked globally on `db`, not the tenant db — safe today since Phase 2/3 will introduce those references, but the deactivate-vs-delete decision should query tenant_db (tdb) once those references are wired, otherwise cross-tenant transactions could unexpectedly protect a child in another tenant.

child_skus.py list_child_skus uses `db.master_skus` (global) while accounts are read from tenant_db — confirm master_skus is deliberately global; if a multi-tenant SKU catalog is used, parent name resolution may leak across tenants.

customer_account_id lookup in create/update uses `$or` on {id} and {account_id} — legacy compatibility is fine, but this could mask mistakes where a truncated legacy id is reused; consider deprecating the account_id fallback once data is migrated.
seed_data_creation: None — all test children created during runs were cleaned up. 24 Brand (id 8bc87348-5398-4604-92d8-eff59610b7f9) left with allows_child_skus=true and zero children.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_319_child_skus.py can be re-run any time; it self-cleans. Login uses httpOnly session_token cookie (no JWT header); requests.Session persists cookies automatically. Master SKU list response shape is {"skus": [...]}. Account list is at /api/accounts?page=1&page_size=100 with response.data array. Frontend account dropdown is a Radix Select with a data-testid=child-sku-account-search input; use role=option to pick items (wait 200-400ms after opening).
rca of the issue: No issues found. Phase 1 implementation of child SKUs (backend routes, frontend ChildSkuManager, SKUManagement toggle & manage button) is working correctly end-to-end.
